matched_fpr_fit: clean test diagnostic only; no attack fit

policy.mapping: first grid t_k >= availability, within numerical tolerance; latest causal residual per PRN is retained
policy.prn_identity_usage: grouping and diagnostics only; never a score feature

source_index_decision.target_window_index: not used as a global key: it is history/channel local
source_index_decision.window_bin_s: not used: it can precede residual availability

policy.tie_break: maximum availability, then lexicographically maximum SHA-256 of stable row content
